name: @labsetu/db
description: Prisma schema, RLS security policies and seed data for LabSetu
//: Env lives in the repo root .env; dotenv-cli hands it to Prisma, which would otherwise only look in packages/db.

scripts.migrate: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate dev && npm run security:apply
scripts.migrate:deploy: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate deploy && npm run security:apply
scripts.reset: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && npm run security:apply && npm run seed

//deps: contracts and crypto are seed-time only; the runtime client needs neither.
